
  it("declares software acceptance as cold-seat qualified while retaining the physical installation evidence tier", () => {
    const profile = json("unity/Fixtures/underdrain.player-product.json");
    expect(profile).toMatchObject({
      productId: "underdrain-bloom-below-unity6000-v1",
      softwareAcceptance: {
        comprehensionMode: "role-separated-cold-seat",
        comprehensionReceiptFormat: "rodoh-underdrain-cold-seat-comprehension/1",
        humanRequired: false,
        runtimeMayIssueReceipt: false,
      },
      physicalAcceptance: {
        humanPlayEvidence: "separate",
        householdInstallationEvidence: "separate",
        questEvidence: "separate",
        coldSeatMayClaimHumanEvidence: false,
        requiredForWindowsSoftwareAcceptance: false,
      },
    });
  });

  it("keeps the Unity batch mechanics-only while recording the software and physical evidence boundary", () => {
    const batch = read("unity/Packages/com.axm.rodoh-action/Editor/ActionPlayerProductBatch.cs");
    expect(batch).toContain('public string coldSeatComprehension;');
    expect(batch).toContain('public string physicalHumanEvidence;');
    expect(batch).toContain('coldSeatComprehension = "open"');
    expect(batch).toContain('physicalHumanEvidence = "separate-open"');
    expect(batch).toContain('humanEvidence = "separate-open"');
    expect(batch).toContain('productAcceptance = "not-issued"');
    expect(batch).not.toContain('rodoh-underdrain-cold-seat-comprehension/1');
  });

  it("documents the replacement transaction without claiming physical human evidence", () => {
    const doc = read("docs/UNDERDRAIN_COLD_SEAT_COMPREHENSION.md");
    expect(doc).toContain("supersedes the human-staffing language");
    expect(doc).toContain("Cold player seat");
    expect(doc).toContain("Cold observer seat");
    expect(doc).toContain("Cold adjudicator seat");
    expect(doc).toContain("Software-product acceptor seat");
    expect(doc).toContain("The same operator may invoke these functions sequentially");
    expect(doc).toContain("humanEvidenceClaimed = false");
    expect(doc).toContain("physicalInstallationEvidence = separate-open");
    expect(doc).toContain("A cold-seat pass may never be described as human acceptance");
  });
});
